approvedBy: Owner-authorized fair-use editorial review by Codex on 2026-09-28
editionLabel: Mattel English instruction sheet, item GDR44
firstPlayerRule: Each player draws a card and reveals the Light Side; the player who draws the highest number is the dealer (any card with a symbol counts as zero). The dealer shuffles and deals each player 7 cards, then the person to the left of the dealer starts play.
houseFallback: If two or more players tie for the highest card when choosing the dealer, this site's house-rule fallback is to have just the tied players draw again.
clarifications: This edition's rules do not include a special first-turn exception for an Action Card being turned up to start the discard pile beyond the game's normal Functions of Action Cards section; no Reverse-card-goes-first exception is stated.
internalEvidence: Fetched the official Mattel instruction-sheet PDF and extracted its English text with pdftotext. Setup: "2. Each player draws a card and then reveals the Light Side; the player that draws the highest number is the dealer (count any card with a symbol as zero). 3. The dealer shuffles and deals each player 7 cards." "LET'S PLAY, The person to the left of the dealer starts play." No wording elsewhere in the document overrides this for the light or dark side.
uncertainty: No tie-break is stated for the dealer-selection draw if two players draw equally high cards.
This English sheet does not specify a special exception when an Action Card is the first card turned face up on the discard pile beyond the general action-card rules.
